name: RoboMaster Referee System Power Management Module PM02

files.note: Includes cables/aviation connectors (hence 375 mm length). Has real-ish colours: dark grey 0.196, black 0.078, light grey 0.753, yellow (1,0.78,0)/(1,0.80,0) for XT30/XT60, white.

download_url_alt: https://rm-static.djicdn.com/tem/17348/RoboMaster Referee System Power Management Module PM02.STEP (same byte size, 50543005)

dims_mm.source: PM02 spec (wiki 809902); manual drawing shows 70 x 48 with 20.50 side dimension

colors: Black anodised finned aluminium housing with white 'ROBOMASTER / POWER MANAGEMENT MODULE' print and port labels; yellow XT30 outputs (Chassis, Gimbal, Ammo-Booster, Mini PC); red/black XT60 input leads; white GH ports (Armor x2, RFID, CAN); black cables to aviation connectors.
notes: DJI labelling is inconsistent: robomaster.com page 2608 is titled 'PM01' but serves 'PM02.STEP'; the wiki's archived 'PM01 2019.STEP' is byte-identical in size and header to this file; the bundled manual's cover says 'PM01 v1.0 2018.11'. The model matches the PM02 spec (70 x 48 footprint, ports for Mini PC/Armor/RFID/CAN as in the current wiki photo). It is a surface model, so it may need sewing if a solid is required.
